sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-018 documents confirmed card-not-present fraud involving customer SC-03018 and card SC-03018-K948. The investigation identified three unauthorized transactions (4012167, 4012168, 4012169) totaling $924.93 in exposure. Real-time monitoring scored the initial transaction at 0.87 risk, triggering review [EV-bac0c827]. Transaction velocity analysis revealed three online purchases within a 48-hour window, deviating from the card's historical average of $295.37 per transaction [EV-da6fef82, EV-b998555e]. The device fingerprint matched a profile previously associated with confirmed fraud [EV-865610cb]. The customer reported no authorization of the transactions and confirmed physical card possession [EV-832d3a9b]. A prior fraud case (CC-4319) exists for this customer/card combination [EV-362bfe0a]. Pattern matching retrieved six similar card-not-present fraud cases, indicating a recurring modus operandi [EV-3a06fc4c]. The verdict of fraud is supported by device reuse, velocity anomalies, customer dispute, and historical pattern alignment. Funds recovery and card reissuance are recommended.
